summary: The per-context structured error callback was added by these changes. The fixed old harness does not install it.

claims.necessity_reason: The callback configures error reporting for the XInclude context that the target creates and processes.

before.requirement: Reach a per-context structured error callback during XInclude processing.
before.reason: The before context had no callback fields or setter, and XInclude errors passed a null structured callback.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The verified preimage has no definition of the context callback setter.

after.requirement: Reach a per-context structured error callback during XInclude processing when a handler is installed on that context.
after.reason: The added setter establishes callback state and XInclude errors consume it, but the fixed harness never calls the setter.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Structured dispatch invokes the context callback when supplied.

claims.comparison_reason: The same callback-delivery tuple was unavailable before and is supported after. The old harness remains fixed and cannot establish the new context callback state.

missing_information: This timing packet assesses only c2; it does not establish complete coverage of the other change groups or resolve the separate allocation-failure claim.
